title: KYC Documentation Matrix — Personal Sender Account Levels
content:
To hold a given verification level of the Personal Sender Account, the documents marked "required" for that level must be accepted and on file. The matrix below sets out, level by level, which verification documents that means.

| Document | Paloma Starter | Paloma Verified | Paloma Verified Plus | Paloma Enhanced | Paloma Premier | Paloma Private Client |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Government photo ID (accepted, unexpired) | not required | required | required | required | required | required |
| Selfie liveness check (accepted) | not required | required | required | required | required | required |
| SSN or ITIN record (accepted) | not required | not required | required | required | required | required |
| Proof of US address (accepted) | not required | not required | required | required | required | required |
| Occupation-and-employer declaration (accepted) | not required | not required | required | required | required | required |
| Source-of-funds document (accepted) | not required | not required | not required | required | required | required |
| Consecutive monthly bank statements accepted (number) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 3 | 6 |
| Enhanced-due-diligence questionnaire (accepted) | not required | not required | not required | not required | required | required |

A bank statement count of 0 means bank statements are not required at that level.

## Notes on the matrix

- Requirements accumulate: every document required at one level is also required at each level above it.
- Paloma Starter requires no document at all.
- The bank statement row is a count, not a yes-or-no: Paloma Premier needs 3 consecutive monthly statements accepted on file, Paloma Private Client needs 6.
- The step from Paloma Verified Plus to Paloma Enhanced adds exactly one document, the source-of-funds document; the step from Paloma Enhanced to Paloma Premier adds the bank statements and the enhanced-due-diligence questionnaire.
